description: This file defines the 'Trends' class which provides statistical trend analysis functions such as correlation, covariance, linear regression, exponential growth, and related calculation utilities within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library.

classes.name: Trends
classes.description: Provides static methods for various statistical trend analyses including correlation, covariance, regression, and prediction functions.

methods.name: filterTrendValues
methods.description: Removes boolean, string, or null values from trend data arrays to prepare them for analysis.

methods.name: checkTrendArrays
methods.description: Ensures input arrays are valid for trend analysis by flattening, filtering, and aligning their sizes.

methods.name: validateTrendArrays
methods.description: Checks if data arrays meet the necessary conditions (e.g., same length, non-zero) for trend calculations.

methods.name: CORREL
methods.description: Calculates the correlation coefficient between two data series.

methods.name: COVAR
methods.description: Calculates the covariance between two data series.

methods.name: FORECAST
methods.description: Predicts a future value based on existing data using linear trend analysis.

methods.name: GROWTH
methods.description: Calculates exponential growth values along a predicted trend.

methods.name: INTERCEPT
methods.description: Calculates the y-intercept of the trend line based on data series.

methods.name: LINEST
methods.description: Performs linear regression analysis, returning regression statistics and parameters.

methods.name: LOGEST
methods.description: Performs exponential regression analysis, returning statistics and parameters for the exponential trend.

methods.name: RSQ
methods.description: Calculates the coefficient of determination (R-squared) for data series.

methods.name: SLOPE
methods.description: Calculates the slope of the linear regression line.

methods.name: STEYX
methods.description: Calculates the standard error of predicted y-values for regression.

methods.name: TREND
methods.description: Returns y-values along a linear trend based on regression analysis.
